opening.text: I've lost weight without trying over the last 3 months and I have pain. I've had diarrhea or I've been going to the toilet more often, and I'm tired all the time or my sleep isn't restful. I have chronic pancreatitis, I smoke cigarettes, and someone in my family has been diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.
